proof_body:
by
  intro f L a b hf
  constructor
  · have h : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (x, b)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) a :=
      (hasDerivAt_id a).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const a b)
    exact HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt a hf h
  · have h : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (a, y)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) b :=
      (hasDerivAt_const b a).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id b)
    exact HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt b hf h
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a b : ℝ), HasFDerivAt f L (a, b) → HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => f (x, b)) (L (1, 0)) a ∧ HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => f (a, y)) (L (0, 1)) b
